summary:
Iter 54 — Security-audit regression testing (SEC-001/002/004/005 + auth/PIN/registry/POS regressions). Backend 17/17 PASS (/app/backend/tests/test_iter54_sec_regression.py, junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/iter54_results.xml). Frontend SEC-002 UI verified via Playwright. ALL 6 SECURITY FIXES CONFIRMED WORKING, ZERO REGRESSIONS FOUND.

VERIFIED FIXES:
- SEC-001 (referral deferral + replay-guard): public /book/{slug} with referral_code → new customer created with ₹100 welcome credit; referrer credit UNCHANGED at booking time; first invoice for that customer → referrer +₹100 exactly once; second invoice → NO further credit (replay guard holds). Delta observed: before=X, after_booking=X, after_inv1=X+100, after_inv2=X+100.
- SEC-002 (public registry name verifier + aadhaar masking): GET /public/registry/search?q=STF-00001 (no name) → 400 with 'name'; +&name=Ravi → 200 with aadhaar_masked='XXXX-XXXX-XXXX' (no last-4 leak). GET /public/registry/STF-00001/pdf → 400 without name, 200 with ?name=Ravi. Frontend /staff-registry: name input hidden for non-STF query, appears when q starts with STF, search returns Ravi Test Kumar profile with fully masked aadhaar.
- SEC-004 (owner-pin lockout): 5× wrong PIN on /branch-switch/owner-pin → 403 each; 6th → 423 'Too many wrong PIN attempts'; correct PIN also blocked during lockout (423). After db.pin_attempts.delete_many({}) cleanup, correct PIN=4321 → 200 ok. Lockout state cleaned up at end.
- SEC-005 (must_change_password gate): staff user priya.staff@miracurl.com (must_change_password=false) unblocked on /customers business endpoint — no PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED false-positive. Admin fully unaffected (login/me/refresh/logout all 200).

REGRESSIONS VERIFIED:
- Auth: admin login + /me + /refresh (cookie) + /logout all 200; post-logout /me → 401.
- Owner-PIN staff flow: POST /staff without header → 403 OWNER_PIN_REQUIRED AND pin_attempts collection remains empty (does NOT count toward lockout) ✅. With X-Owner-Pin=4321 → staff created; DELETE with same header → cleaned.
- Authenticated registry: GET /registry/employees?q=STF-00001 as admin returns unredacted profile with real aadhaar last-4 (pattern XXXX-XXXX-#### matched).
- POS/invoice normal checkout: /invoices for existing customer with items[{type:'service',ref_id,...}] returns 200 with total field.
- Settings/late-fines, /sms-packs, /entertainment endpoints: /settings/late-fines 200, /sms-packs 200 (enabled=true, packs present); /entertainment path not found via probe (skipped — may be frontend-only page, main agent to confirm route name).
critical_code_review_comments: SEC-001 deferral (server.py _apply_referral_credit ~L3450 + create_invoice ~L2990): correctly uses a pending marker on the referred customer that gets consumed atomically by the first invoice creation. Replay-guard verified: 2nd invoice does not re-credit — good idempotency.

SEC-002 registry public search: _name_matches / name verifier prevents PII enumeration by staff_code alone. Consider adding a low-noise rate-limit hit metric (already limited to 10/10min per iter53 notes) — good.

SEC-004 pin_attempts lockout: uses (tenant_id) as key with 5-strike threshold. IMPORTANT — verified: OWNER_PIN_REQUIRED (missing header) does NOT increment attempts, only wrong PIN values do. That is the correct UX so normal 'first hit → prompt → retry' doesn't lock users out. LGTM.
SEC-005 get_current_user gate: correctly whitelists /api/auth/* paths so a must_change_password user can still call change-password endpoint. Regression proven — priya.staff normal user unaffected.
server.py still ~6400+ lines; router split for security/pin/branch-switch/sms-packs is still outstanding (called out in iter50-53). No functional bug — just tech-debt reminder.

Minor: /entertainment endpoint route name unclear from server.py grep — the frontend page may hit a different path (e.g. /videos, /content). Recommend main agent confirm the route name in the Entertainment page component; test was skipped safely.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for SEC-002 UI (conditional name input + masked aadhaar profile render)

(c) pin_attempts lockout row created during SEC-004 test — cleared via db.pin_attempts.delete_many({}) at test end; correct PIN=4321 confirmed working. No LIVE Razorpay payment attempted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_iter54_sec_regression.py for future security regressions. Key notes: (1) The referral deferral test does its own cleanup of the created customer + invoices via direct mongo delete_many (tenant_id filter). (2) SEC-004 test wipes pin_attempts twice (before and after) to guarantee clean lockout state — safe to re-run. (3) Invoice payload requires items[].type and items[].ref_id (not just service_id) — 422 otherwise. (4) Authenticated registry endpoint is /registry/employees?q=... (not /registry/search). (5) Entertainment endpoint route not found by probing common paths — check EntertainmentPage.jsx for actual fetch URL if needed.
